description: This file defines terminal handling for a VT100-compatible terminal, including escape sequences, input line editing, history management, and terminal size adjustments, as part of the 'golang.org/x/term' package.

classes.name: EscapeCodes
classes.description: Contains escape sequences for terminal text styling, including foreground colors and reset.

classes.name: History
classes.description: Interface for managing a bounded queue of input lines read by the terminal.

classes.name: Terminal
classes.description: Represents the state and behavior of a VT100-compatible terminal, including input handling, output, and terminal size management.

methods.name: NewTerminal
methods.description: Initializes a new Terminal instance with specified io.ReadWriter and prompt.

methods.name: ReadLine
methods.description: Reads a line of input from the terminal, handling editing and history.

methods.name: ReadPassword
methods.description: Reads a password input from the terminal without echoing.

methods.name: SetPrompt
methods.description: Sets the prompt string for subsequent input lines.

methods.name: SetSize
methods.description: Adjusts the terminal's width and height, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: SetBracketedPasteMode
methods.description: Enables or disables bracketed paste mode for the terminal.
